children: New Delhi, Sept. 3 -- Despite tepid movement in the key benchmark indices of the Indian stock market, IFCI shares saw strong buying in the early morning session. IFCI share price today opened with a downside gap at Rs.98.21 apiece on the NSE, but the PSU stock soon gathered an upside momentum and touched an intraday high of Rs.101.66 per share. However, the NBFC stock failed to sustain gains and hit an intraday low of Rs.95.90 apiece, a level that may attract bottom fishers.

According to stock market experts, IFCI shares have given a technical breakout at Rs.95, and the PSU stock appears bullish on the technical chart. They said that shareholders with a long-term horizon may hold the stock for an upside target of Rs.120. However, experts recommended a strict stop loss at Rs.90. A fresh investor may also consider buying this NBFC PSU stock, maintaining the same stop-loss for the above-mentioned target of Rs.120 over the next one to two months.

Speaking on the outlook of IFCI shares, Sumeet Bagadia, Executive Director at Choice Broking, said, "The PSU stock is looking strong on the technical chart and may bounce back after the profit-booking trigger at the new 52-week high. The stock has made a strong base at Rs.90 per share levels, and IFCI shareholders may consider holding the scrip with a stop loss at Rs.90 for the short-term targets of Rs.110 and Rs.120."
The Choice Broking expert said that IFCI shareholders can expect a target of Rs.120 in the next one to two months.

Whether one should consider buying IFCI shares after the fall from the 52-week high, Mahesh M Ojha, VP - Research & Business Development at KC Securities, said, "The PSU stock is still looking strong on the technical chart, and one can consider buying IFCI shares at around the Rs.92- Rs.95 range. The stock may soon bounce back and touch Rs.102, Rs.108 and Rs.120+ targets in the short-term time horizon."
IFCI share price has delivered 25% in one month, 80% in six months, and a whopping 750% returns in the last five years.
